description: A wire with a spring-jaw clip on one or both ends, for gripping a bare wire or component leg directly.
how_to_use: Clip one end onto the bare leg or wire end you need to reach, plug or clip the other end onto the target (an Arduino pin, another lead, or a second bare leg) — the one solderless way to connect two points that aren't both sitting in breadboard holes, since a plain jumper wire's pin end has nothing to grip a bare leg with.

plain.what: A wire with a spring clip on each end that bites onto legs or wires.
plain.how: Squeeze the clip open, let it grip a bare leg or wire. Great for quick tests without a breadboard — no soldering needed.
